heading: Start
a project
copy: Every project is priced to fit, so the first step is a short conversation. Answer a few questions and I'll come back with thoughts, a rough scope, and a time to talk.
next: A confirmation email arrives right away, so you know I received it.
I reply myself within a few days.
smallPrint: Your answers are emailed only to me. Nothing here commits you to anything.
